registration.objective: mean_over_frames(sum_xyz((prediction-target)^2)) + 0.01*sum(weights^2); unpenalized intercept; same fixed lambda for every method/role/label.
registration.train_stat_scope: original train30 only; excludes all41 corrections and independent validation6

representation.computation: native_data.residual_visual -> model.vision.read over last3 actual RGB-D spatial tokens plus frame age/valid; updated every control observation.
representation.labels_only: Pre-action diagnostic object and palm poses enter ridge targets only. No policy, controller, model normalization, sampling, cache or current round04 run is changed.

coordinates.phases: First observation with contact_valid and any five-finger observed world force >0.1N in either already completed physics substep; subsequent observations remain postcontact even if contact is later lost. Force includes any contacting body, not privileged object-filtered force.
coordinates.observation_alignment: All features and labels use the same actual pre-action time; recorded observed forces equal previous transition substeps. Initial invalid force is not counted as contact.

interpretation: Fixed frozen-representation decodability on30 successful training families and6 independent successful validation families. A low probe error does not establish that the current policy uses position, that a position estimator is deployed, or any closed-loop grasp/insertion benefit. Narrow scripted-motion correlations can make robot-only position decoding strong. Probe sees the last three real visual frames, not the persistent visual GRU. Validation6 has been reused for student model selection and development; it is not an untouched final test. No intervention or causal vision claim.
